figure.title: Aerodynamic characteristics in pitch of the various wing-body configurations. (f) Λ = 47°; t/c = 0.12, 0.06, 0.06. (Page caption: 'Figure 6.- Concluded.')
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, C_L, common to the three plots of the page and labelled only under the bottom (angle-of-attack) plot: -.2 at the left frame line, 0 at the heavy axis line, .8 at the right frame line, labels every 0.1. On the graph paper the heavy vertical lines fall every 0.05 C_L (about 71.3 px on this page), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.025), fine lines every 0.005 (about 7.1 px). The C_L = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, C_D, scale on the right of the middle plot: labels 0, .04, .08, .12, .16, .20. The heavy horizontal lines fall every 0.02 C_D (about 71.7 px; the labels sit on every second one, printed a few px below their line), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.01), fine lines every 0.002 (about 7.2 px). The C_D = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.content_note: Middle plot of the page only (C_D against C_L). One faired curve with 8 hollow circles (radius about 13 px), all single: no doubled outline or second circle seen. Circle 1 sits on a grid crossing: the heavy -0.10 C_L line runs through its centre and the 0.03 C_D line close to it; circle 2 has its left stroke almost touching the heavy C_L = 0 axis line and its top stroke merged with the 0.03 C_D line, with the faired curve through it; circle 4 has the heavy 0.04 C_D line through its centre; circle 5 has the heavy 0.06 C_D line across its upper part and the 0.325 C_L line through it; circle 6 has the 0.425 C_L line through it. This page sits about 30 px lower on the scan than pages 18-22 (C_D = 0 line at y about 1644, 0.20 line at about 926); the .20 label is printed about 8 px below its grid line. The scan is slightly rotated (horizontal lines about 6 px higher at the right frame than at the left), the left frame line steps by about 2 px at y about 1621, and the horizontal lines show 1-px steps along vertical seams (e.g. near x 577, 727 and 1769).

calibration.x_definition: C_L: vertical heavy and medium grid lines of the graph paper, every 0.025 from the left frame line (-0.20) to the right frame line (0.80).
calibration.y_definition: C_D: horizontal heavy and medium grid lines, every 0.01 from the heavy C_D = 0 line (labelled 0) to the 0.20 line (labelled .20).
